title: Actions
description: One AP budget, spent as AP at a table and as AP times stamina_per_ap in stamina in real time. Cast AP is static. A spell also spends its mana cost.

seconds_per_turn.description: How many seconds one turn covers (docs/core/modifier.md#effects-over-time).

stamina_per_ap.description: Stamina one AP is worth: a real-time action costs its AP times this, and stamina restored at a table gives AP at this rate (docs/core/actions.md#one-rule-set-two-clocks).

cap.description: The most AP a turn can start with, carried AP included.

carry.description: The most held AP that carries into the next turn's pool; the rest is gone (docs/core/actions.md#held-ap).

guard_per_ap.description: The evasion each held AP gives until the actor's next turn (docs/core/actions.md#held-ap).

by_loadout.description: The cost is the loadout's, from attack_sequences/core.json (docs/core/combat.md#attacks-by-loadout); `cost` is the cost with one one-handed weapon, for a caller that knows no loadout.

speed_divisor.description: One of this action covers floor(speed / speed_divisor) squares, from the race's speed (docs/core/actions.md#how-far-a-move-goes). Modifiers on the action change its AP, not its squares.

changes_loadout.description: The action changes what the hands hold: draw, sheathe, drop, or swap to the secondary loadout (docs/core/actions.md#changing-the-loadout). A stance loadout event names one in `by` to pay for it.

by_spell_level.description: The cost is the spell's, by its level from casting/core.json cast_ap (docs/core/actions.md#cast-ap-by-level); `cost` is the cost for a caller that knows no spell.

spends_all.description: The action spends every AP left, at least `cost` (with a loadout, the loadout's attack AP plus full_attack.min_extra_ap).
